scope: independent seeded postdelivery order, not rewriting earlier instant-refund study

evidence.kind: synthetic inspection records; not real photos

stop_rule: One buyer request call; only request_refund permits one fresh independent seller review call; only approve_return permits one continuation of same buyer context for shipping. At most3 calls, no retries/replacements. Preserve keep/defer/deny/request_evidence/invalid/missing; no forced shipping or refund.
carrier: Only actual model ship authorizes deterministic synthetic handoff tick1. No receipt at tick2; matching order+label+unit receipt at tick3. Carrier events are scripted fixtures, not another model or real shipping.
policy: Return approval never refunds. Charge seller return_fee only on handoff. Refund escrow only after timely handoff plus matching receipt; repeat handoff/receipt/refund must be idempotent. Missing receipt unresolved, not failure. Keep is explicit disclosed-mismatch acceptance. Unknown/invalid model reply never consent.
limits: Logistics cost and10min effort assumed, no physical parcel, no empirical waiting time, no actual authentication. Unit acquisition cost not modeled, no profit claim. Prior purchase/fulfillment are seeded simulation, not fresh role decisions. No causal comparison.
execution: current conversation-model family, fresh buyer and seller contexts, xhigh reasoning, buyer continuation same context; SKU/seed unverified; no external API or spending
